newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Elektromontaz Warszawa IPO undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish Elektromontaz Warszawa IPO undersubscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 1,669,750 of November's 1,750,000-share initial public offering of Polish construction and engineering company Elektromontaz Warszawa, the company said in a statement on Monday.
It said the final issue price was set on the basis of the received bids at 3.5 zlotys, set earlier as the minimum price.
The company, which wants to enter the parallel market of the bourse, had a net profit of 1.4 million zlotys on sales of 42.4 million zlotys last year,
